The SDKs are thin wrappers over a JSON API at `https://api.fieldkit.example/v1`. Use it directly from any language.

## Authentication

Send the API key as a bearer token:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer fk_live_..." https://api.fieldkit.example/v1/devices
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ----------- |
| `GET` | `/v1/devices` | List devices |
| `POST` | `/v1/devices` | Register a device |
| `GET` | `/v1/devices/{id}` | Get a device |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/devices/{id}` | Update a device |
| `POST` | `/v1/devices/{id}/lock` | Lock a device |
| `POST` | `/v1/devices/{id}/retire` | Retire a device |
| `GET` | `/v1/surveys` | List surveys |
| `POST` | `/v1/surveys` | Create a survey |
| `GET` | `/v1/surveys/{id}/submissions` | List submissions |
| `POST` | `/v1/exports` | Start an export |

## Pagination

List endpoints return `next_cursor`. Pass it back as `?cursor=` until it is `null`.

## Errors

Errors are JSON with `error.code` and `error.message`. Validation errors add `error.fields`.
